summary: Requested a repeat execution of the fixed witness experiment 29a71a7377a44fdbac949d4808f7b847-experiment. Its receipt (01617c5662f34c3eb21857602f6cac4f) is the only evidence for the strongest safety-relevant claim in this run — that an isolated, stalled leader can return VerifyLeader success while a successor already leads at a higher term — and it rests on a single execution whose six trials split three successes to three leadership losses. The retest re-runs the same fixed inputs in a clean copy and asks whether the overlap still appears in every trial and whether the split stays of the same order under the same stall, partition, reconnection delays and timeouts; nothing is claimed until the new receipt exists. The current account stands as recorded. I also read the FSM runner's apply, barrier and restore paths without finding a defect to register: every future in a batch is responded to, including barriers, and index tracking is updated after each batch. Unfinished: interpreting the repeat receipt and deciding whether any further lead is worth pursuing in the remaining run time.
